assets.prompt: Create one polished medical textbook illustration for an adult mobile anatomy course, landscape 3:2, white background, refined realistic medical painting, calm muted red muscle fibers, pearly tendons. assets.editPrompt: Edit this educational medical illustration. Preserve the liver, all layout, muscle bundle and two inset circles, fine white background and original rendering quality. Correct one precise anatomical error ONLY: in the main transverse cut face of the skeletal muscle bundle at upper right, there are purple nucleus-like dots within the CENTER of several individual muscle fibers. Remove ALL central nucleus-like dark purple dots from that main cut face. If any muscle nuclei are shown, put them at the OUTERMOST EDGE of individual muscle fibers beneath their sarcolemma; healthy adult skeletal muscle nuclei are peripheral. Preserve realistic pale connective tissue septa and small capillaries BETWEEN fibers. The longitudinal muscle-cell inset at bottom right should also keep purple myonuclei at its fiber boundaries, never within the central cytoplasm. Do not change liver hepatocyte nuclei: their central nuclei are correct and must remain. No new text, labels, numbers, arrows or other changes.
